blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Justice (DOJ) on Thursday said Batangas Rep. Leandro Leviste is not yet considered a fugitive, contrary to the statement of NBI Director Melvin Matibag. In a press conference, Senior Deputy State Prosecutor Herbert Abugan said that declaring an accused a fugitive entails a process that must be observed. “The court will give him an opportunity to appear before it at the scheduled hearing. And until then, we will see the next steps of the case,” Abugan said. The Makati Regional Trial Court (RTC) scheduled Leviste’s arraignment for Oct. 26.
